question: Can source-reconstructed noncommutative target-relative SO3 hypotheses outperform a per-variant trained, reset-relative SO3 nearest-prototype baseline in real PhysX hidden ACK recovery?
primary_endpoint: achieved public EE orientation angular geodesic difference in radians relative to the source-reconstructed all-applied goal, after history-conditioned controller correction and eight zero-hold steps
supplementary_endpoints: history accuracy of each nonprivileged classifier
training_prototype_rule: For RESET_SO3_BY_VARIANT and RESET_SO3_POOLED train deterministic unit-quaternion signed-aligned arithmetic-average prototype per true ACK history on training seeds; all features are measured EE orientation * inverse(public achieved reset EE orientation), no private controller targets. SOURCE_SO3_HYPOTHESES requires NO training, computes source-predicted four target quaternions directly for announced variant.
classifier_metric: scipy Rotation geodesic distance; tie break history order [00,01,10,11] to within 1e-12
recovery_mechanism: For predicted target quaternion Q_guess and desired Q_goal, compute delta=Q_goal * inverse(Q_guess), express in source's XYZ Euler chart; normalize by controller signed rot_lower and refuse norm>1, apply common source-valid 6D native action.
prospective_novelty_gate: SOURCE_SO3_HYPOTHESES mean heldout orientation error lower than RESET_SO3_BY_VARIANT and NO_ACTION on >=3 of 4 independent reset seeds FOR EACH robot, with absolute per-seed improvement at least 0.01 rad versus variant-aware baseline. Failure disproves unique source reconstruction advantage for this constrained task.
high_priority_negative_interpretation: If per-variant trained reset-relative SO3 performs equally well, source residual does NOT demonstrate unique novelty even if it greatly beats pooled reset baseline.
independence_statement: Training/test seed cohorts disjoint; 2 nominal variant families and 4 hidden histories under the same seed are repeated paired conditions, NOT 8 independent physical subjects per seed.
forbidden_claims: source novel if equally good as per-variant reset baseline
trained VLA or ToM model deployed
true hardware packet delivery faults; held simulated by zero native command
PickCube grasp success unless official flag has actual successes
external scholarly peer review or published paper
